narratives.Description: The 0.130.1 consumer .gitignore block adds .deft/*, which also hides .deft/directive/data-schema.json, so a fresh install leaves that Directive file out of its first commit. The fix adds !.deft/directive/ and !.deft/directive/** to the block and re-ignores .deft/directive/wiring-ready.*.json after them. Setup, doctor and uninstall handle the new lines like the other ! lines, and a fresh-install test proves the file is committed and doctor reports no hidden Directive file.
narratives.Overview:
The 0.130.1 consumer `.gitignore` block (#6834 / #6795) adds `.deft/*`. That rule also hides `.deft/directive/data-schema.json`, a Directive file that must be committed. A fresh 0.130.1 install leaves the file out of its first commit (137 files, no `data-schema.json`; the 0.129.15 deposit includes it), so a clone of the project is missing it. 0.130.1's own doctor reports it:

> warning: Directive file .deft/directive/data-schema.json is hidden from git by .gitignore:8 ('.deft/*'). Directive's own files must stay committable. Remove or narrow that rule.

Upgrades from earlier versions are not affected, because the file was already tracked. Found by a fresh-install consumer check (internal benchmark evidence (private)).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The deposited `.gitignore` keeps `.deft/directive/` trackable (`!.deft/directive/` and `!.deft/directive/**`), then re-ignores `.deft/directive/wiring-ready.*.json` after those lines.
- [ ] Setup, doctor and uninstall handle the new lines the same way as the other `!` lines in the block.
- [ ] A test runs a fresh install, commits the deposit, and asserts that `.deft/directive/data-schema.json` is in the commit and that `directive doctor --full` reports no hidden Directive file.
- [ ] One CHANGELOG fragment states the fix in one line, with no file lists, referencing this issue.

Refs #6834, #6795, #6808

narratives.UserStory: As a Directive consumer doing a fresh install, I want the deposited .gitignore to keep .deft/directive/ trackable, so that my first commit includes .deft/directive/data-schema.json and a clone of my project is complete.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Allow-list (#6842): in packages/core/src/install-health/owned-paths.ts add !.deft/directive/ and !.deft/directive/** to the ordered .deft/* block in DIRECTIVE_GITIGNORE_LINES, then .deft/directive/wiring-ready.*.json after them, so readiness markers stay ignored.
- Setup and doctor: ensureGitignore (packages/runtime/src/setup.ts) and checkGitignoreCoverage (packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts) already re-append and order-check the block; adjust only if the moved wiring-ready line needs it. Uninstall classifies the lines through isDirectiveLine in owned-paths.ts.
- Tests: owned-paths.test.ts and doctor-read-only.test.ts pin the new order; setup.test.ts checks the deposit; session-start-gitignore-6795.test.ts runs a fresh install, commits the deposit, asserts .deft/directive/data-schema.json is in the commit and doctor --full reports no hidden Directive file.
- Changelog: one fragment changelog.d/6842-gitignore-deft-directive.md.
